characters.name: Kaelen Voss
characters.background: Once a decorated general in the Northern Coalition, Kaelen abandoned his post after the Siege of Varnhold, where he was forced to sacrifice an entire battalion to maintain a strategic advantage. He now lives under an alias in the slums of Drenmar, selling outdated military schematics to survive. His left hand trembles when stressed, a nervous condition developed during prolonged exposure to warzone stimulants. He drinks blackroot tea every evening to calm his nerves, a habit picked up from a field medic who saved his life.
characters.motivation: To dismantle the military-industrial complex that turned soldiers into disposable assets

relationships.c2: Former mentor and now ideological rival; Kaelen blames Rhis for promoting the doctrines he now opposes.
relationships.c4: Secretly protects her from coalition agents, though she doesn't know his true identity.

characters.name: Rhis Taryn
characters.background: As the current High Strategist of the Northern Coalition, Rhis engineered the campaign that won the Riverlands but at a devastating human cost. Orphaned during the Collapse, he rose through merit and an uncanny ability to predict enemy movements. He believes stability justifies any sacrifice and sees dissent as a disease. His private journals, locked in a vault beneath Coalition HQ, reveal insomnia and frequent nightmares about faceless soldiers screaming in unison. He once ordered Kaelen to carry out the Varnhold purge, a decision that still haunts his dreams, though he'd never admit it.
characters.motivation: To unify the fractured territories under absolute order, no matter the cost

relationships.c1: Views Kaelen as a brilliant but broken idealist who failed to grasp the burden of command.
relationships.c3: Employs her as an enforcer; trusts her loyalty more than any officer's.

characters.name: Mireya the Red
characters.background: A former gladiator from the Sunken Pits of Korr, Mireya was recruited by Rhis after she killed seven opponents in a single match using only a rusted cleaver. She bears a scar across her throat from a near-fatal injury that left her voice permanently hoarse. Now the head of internal security for the Coalition, she hunts deserters and rebels with terrifying efficiency. She keeps a journal written in blood-ink, detailing every target she's eliminated. Despite her brutality, she fiercely protects a blind girl in her childhood slum district, sending her money anonymously each month.
characters.motivation: To prove that strength alone determines worth, and she is the strongest

relationships.c2: Loyal to Rhis not out of ideology, but because he gave her purpose when no one else would.
relationships.c5: Seeks to capture him after he exposed her side dealings with black-market arms dealers.

characters.name: Elion Pasca
characters.background: Orphaned at ten when his parents were executed for distributing banned histories, Elion grew up in the underground archives of Drenmar, memorizing forbidden texts and decoding encrypted manuscripts. He has a photographic memory and can recite entire volumes from memory, though he stutters when anxious. At sixteen, he uncovered evidence of a secret project called 'Echo Protocol,' which the Coalition tried to erase. Now hunted, he hides in plain sight as a scribe’s apprentice. He unknowingly possesses a key to Rhis’s downfall, encoded in a lullaby his mother used to sing.
characters.motivation: To expose the truth that powerful institutions work to erase

relationships.c1: Unaware of Kaelen’s protection, but admires the anonymous informant who keeps him safe.
relationships.c5: Collaborates with him to decrypt the final pieces of the Echo Protocol.

characters.name: Dorran Vale
characters.background: A disgraced bioengineer, Dorran designed the neural inhibitors used to control war prisoners until he discovered they were being tested on civilians. He faked his death and now operates from a hidden lab beneath an abandoned bathhouse. He suffers from chronic pain due to an experimental implant he tested on himself. His inventions include a memory-extracting device and a prototype cloaking suit made from repurposed surveillance fabric. He sells tech to rebels and criminals alike, not out of idealism, but because the Coalition ruined his reputation. He talks to a mannequin named 'Livia,' pretending she’s his deceased sister.
characters.motivation: To undermine the system that exploited his genius while avoiding redemption

relationships.c3: Wants her dead for destroying his lab and branding him a traitor.
relationships.c4: Supplies him with decryption tools, seeing him as the only hope to expose the truth.
